verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for a cloud agent platform like LiveKit, but the evidence documents no cron-style or recurring job or workflow scheduler. Nearby items do not qualify: always-on agents are a deployment mode, auto-recording is triggered by room creation, and outbound calls are one-off programmatic actions rather than a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
